mapper.insert: INSERT INTO donation_items (title, description, price, category, images, user_name, user_avatar, campus, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{price}, #{category}, #{images}, #{userName}, #{userAvatar}, #{campus}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE donation_items SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, price = #{price}, category = #{category}, images = #{images}, user_name = #{userName}, user_avatar = #{userAvatar}, campus = #{campus}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
